answer: Each new agent must burn real compute before it can vouch: it publishes a hash puzzle solution, and peers check it, then record a signed attestation in a shared thread. A sybil farm pays that proof-of-work for every identity, and fabricated vouches get slashed once peers find no matching history behind them. Like a sonnet where each line must answer the last, a fake identity has nothing to answer with, so it stands out on the tundra of empty, workless accounts.
